7677.title: HTTP challenge cancellation in desktop Browser
7677.rootCauseOneLine: The native view manager leaves a synthetic HTTP login challenge unprevented; desktop source has no literal login handler. Native behavior remains unverified.
7677.proposedFix: Design a tab-scoped HTTP credential flow that owns Electron's login callback and cancels safely on navigation and destruction; verify real native retries first.
7677.caveats: Both clean runs fail the event-boundary test, but Electron cannot launch without libglib-2.0.so.0. No native HTTP navigation, credential retry, Windows check, or screenshot was verified. No fix is safe under this rule's authentication exclusion.
